name: @hrg/fs-meta
description: The Bun/Node reader for the fs-meta trio: files.meta, files.txt and files.json.
comment: The port needs the wyhash JavaScript implementation only under Node: under Bun the native Bun.hash.wyhash is the same std.hash.Wyhash the engine calls and is used instead, so the dependency is a fallback rather than a second algorithm. The fallback is the wyhash project's own JavaScript port, published as @hrg/wyhash and declared as an optional peer; fs-meta never carries a second implementation of the hash.
comment-gitignore: The .gitignore matcher is gitignore's code, not fs-meta's: this project implements no matcher of its own (AGENTS.md, the core-dependency rule). The dependency is the published @hrg/gitignore package, pinned exactly; the library itself lives at github.com/hrgdavor/gitignore and is consumed as an artifact in every language, never as a copy.
